mapper.select: SELECT jsonb_build_object('applicationId',a.id::text,'version',a.published_version, 'definition',v.definition_json->'definition')::text FROM public.nocode_application a JOIN public.nocode_application_version v ON v.application_id=a.id AND v.version_no=a.published_version AND v.deleted=0 WHERE a.deleted=0 AND a.status='ACTIVE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v.definition_json->'definition'->'resources') r WHERE r->>'kind' IN ('AUTOMATION','ACTION','NUMBER_RULE')) ORDER BY a.id
SELECT id::text FROM public.nocode_application WHERE deleted=0 AND status='ACTIVE' AND published_version IS NOT NULL ORDER BY app_name,id
SELECT * FROM public.nocode_application WHERE deleted=1 AND (app_name ILIKE #{search} ESCAPE '!' OR app_code ILIKE #{search} ESCAPE '!') AND creator=#{creator} ORDER BY deleted_at DESC,id DESC
SELECT * FROM public.nocode_application WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE public.nocode_application SET deleted=1,status='DISABLED',deleted_at=clock_timestamp(), deleted_by=#{actor},deleted_reason=#{reason},lock_version=lock_version+1, updater=#{actor},update_time=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM public.nocode_handling_request WHERE application_id=#{id} AND deleted=0 AND status IN #{state}
mapper.update: UPDATE public.nocode_application SET deleted=0,status='DISABLED',recovery_pending=true, restored_at=clock_timestamp(),restored_by=#{actor},restored_reason=#{reason}, recovery_needs_edit=true,lock_version=lock_version+1,updater=#{actor},update_time=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=1

UPDATE public.nocode_application SET status='ACTIVE',recovery_pending=false, recovery_needs_edit=false,updater=#{actor},update_time=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0 AND recovery_pending=true AND recovery_needs_edit=false
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM public.nocode_application WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0 FOR UPDATEFOR SHARE
mapper.update: UPDATE public.nocode_application SET app_name=#{app.appName},category=#{app.category},description=#{app.description},icon=#{app.icon}, design_json=CAST(#{app.designJson} AS jsonb), recovery_needs_edit=CASE WHEN recovery_pending AND recovery_needs_edit THEN NOT (app_name IS DISTINCT FROM #{app.appName} OR category IS DISTINCT FROM #{app.category} OR description IS DISTINCT FROM #{app.description} OR icon IS DISTINCT FROM #{app.icon} OR design_json IS DISTINCT FROM CAST(#{app.designJson} AS jsonb)) ELSE false END, lock_version=lock_version+1,updater=#{actor},update_time=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{app.id} AND lock_version=#{expected} AND deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM public.nocode_application_version WHERE application_id=#{id} AND deleted=0 ORDER BY version_no DESC

SELECT id,application_id,version_no,checksum,reason,creator,create_time,updater,update_time,deleted FROM public.nocode_application_version WHERE application_id=#{id} AND deleted=0 ORDER BY version_no DESC
SELECT * FROM public.nocode_application_version WHERE application_id=#{id} AND version_no=#{number} AND deleted=0
mapper.update: UPDATE public.nocode_application SET published_version=#{number},lock_version=lock_version+1,updater=#{actor},update_time=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
UPDATE public.nocode_application SET status=#{status},lock_version=lock_version+1,updater=#{actor},update_time=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
